ItemID: NA; Title: His Love Remains; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me little reason to expect the holiday music I have enjoyed.

ItemID: NA; Title: That's Life; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Nothing in the title connects clearly enough with my recent listening to draw me in.
ItemID: NA; Title: If I Can Dream: Elvis Presley with the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The orchestral setting has some appeal, but I have little reason to choose Elvis right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTXmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Christmas focus appeals, but I would try A Pentatonix Christmas first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Isaacs Bluegrass-Preserved; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent listening does not suggest enough interest in bluegrass to try this today.
